disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error while auditing one of the LICENSE files, marking it as inconclusive. This tool error propagated to the final verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and correctly marked it safe.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback handling for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) on non-executable files (e.g., LICENSE, README) to prevent them from forcing an 'inconclusive' package verdict.
Tool errors during the audit of purely informational files should not override the security verdict of the actual packaging scripts (PKGBUILD, .install).
